defects.justification: Every unauthenticated POST with a new image (a single changed byte gives a new SHA-256 key) writes up to 10 new files into the cache directory, and the cache has no size limit or eviction, so any client can fill the disk.

Each request buffers the whole source (up to 20 MiB, uploaded or fetched) in memory before it waits on the decode semaphore, and nothing limits the number of in-flight requests, so many concurrent requests can exhaust memory even though decoding itself is limited to 4.
writeJSON discards the error returned by json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(v).
